expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx imports apiProxy from '@mpxjs/api-proxy' and calls mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) before mpx.createApp.

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js imports named request from '@mpxjs/api-proxy' and uses request({ url: '/api/search/trending' }).then(({ data }) => data). The assertion states named imports from @mpxjs/api-proxy do not inherit app-level Promise configuration and cannot be directly used as Promise.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js requestSuggestions returns the named-import request(...) result. outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx then assumes const promise = requestSuggestions(keyword); const task = promise.__returned. Because this is not called through configured mpx.request and no per-call usePromise path is shown, there is insufficient evidence that promise.__returned exists or that a cancellable RequestTask is saved.

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx guards Promise then/catch with task, generation, and keyword checks, but the联想词 request is not wired through success/fail callbacks and the task identity comes from promise.__returned on an invalid named-import Promise assumption. Evidence is insufficient that stale success/fail responses cannot update state.

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx uses mpx.showToast({ title: '搜索失败', icon: 'none' }) for errors and mpx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/product/detail?id=${productId}` }) for product detail navigation.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx no longer uses alert or location, and no fetch is present. However outputs/src/services/search.js still uses named imports from '@mpxjs/api-proxy' without making explicit that those calls do not inherit app-level options/custom/Promise configuration.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx retains trending display, input search, clear behavior, suggestions display, and detail navigation structure, but outputs/src/services/search.js implements both trending and suggestion requests via named-import request used as a Promise. This breaks the required Promise/cancellation chain, so the full business flow is not proven intact.

suggestions: q3 is slightly over-specific by saying success/fail callbacks, while q2 allows a Promise.__returned pattern. To avoid bias, q3 should explicitly accept Promise then/catch handlers when they capture the same task identity and keyword and are reached through a valid Promise-enabled Mpx API path.
eval_feedback.overall: 入口 Promise 插件安装和官方 toast/navigation 链路合格，但 request 服务仍把 @mpxjs/api-proxy named import 当作已 Promise 化入口使用，导致趋势词 Promise、联想词取消任务和旧响应隔离的核心要求不成立。
